description: Trigger evals for dv:manager-mode (the session works as an engineering manager; hired agents with named tiers do the engineering; `off` ends it). Hard near-misses in no_trigger: handing one task to one subagent is ordinary delegation, not the mode; stress-testing a plan with parallel critics is dv:critique; adversarial review of a diff is dv:gauntlet; a handoff is dv:handoff. See tooling/evals/README.md.

queries.q: Switch to manager mode for this session.
Work as the engineering manager here: plan and brief, and let hired agents write all the code.
Manager mode off, just make the change yourself from now on.
Be the manager, not an engineer. Delegate all the engineering on this ticket.
Turn on manager mode and run the team for the next three tickets.
You plan, agents build. Don't touch the code yourself this session.
Go into manager mode: you brief, check and report, and the agents do the work.
Stop managing and go back to doing the work directly.
For the rest of this session act as engineering manager and hire engineers per unit of work.
Load the manager mode text; this project should run that way.
Spawn a subagent to search the repo for every use of this function.
Critique my plan with a skeptic, a simplifier and a historian before I build it.
Run the gauntlet on my branch.
Write a handoff for this session.
Fix the off-by-one in the pagination helper.
Read the handoff and tell me where we left off.
Review my CLAUDE.md for stale rules.
Write a status report for my manager about this sprint.
Summarize this Reddit thread: https://www.reddit.com/r/programming/comments/abc/.
Set up an orca.yaml so new worktrees get their dependencies.
